fields.name: phaseStable
fields.type:
(∀ P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H →
          afterQuery checkEmpty P H source target sourceScs targetScs query queried beforeCaller memos.query =
            (.ok (some (SourcePruningEnumerationAssimilation.finish (EnumGuard := EnumGuard)
              source target handle sourceScs targetScs replacement)), afterCaller, savedQueries))

fields.name: post
fields.type: Post formulas solver next beforeCaller afterCaller final

fields.name: meaning
fields.type:
(∀ ambient term,
          InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient replacement term ↔
            InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient left term ∧
            InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient right term)

fields.name: disabled
fields.type:
(checkEmpty = false → replacement = query ∧
          afterCaller = SourceCurrentAllocatedPartialState.advance beforeCaller queried
            beforeCaller.fourth beforeCaller.merge ∧ final = memos)

fields.name: enabled
fields.type:
(checkEmpty = true → ∃ reached answer guardSaved,
          SourceEndpointMemo.run query memos.query = (reached, guardSaved) ∧
          SourceEndpointMemoCorrect.Checked queried.native.machine.heap memos.query
            (SourceCurrentEmptinessMerge.reaches query) (reached, guardSaved) ∧
          (∀ P H, p ≤ P → h ≤ H →
            SourcePruningEnumerationEnabledEmpty.check P H query queried beforeCaller.fourth memos.query =
              (.done answer afterCaller.checked afterCaller.fourth, guardSaved)) ∧
          savedQueries = guardSaved ∧ replacement = (if answer then .empty else query) ∧
          (reached = false → answer = false ∧ afterCaller.checked = queried ∧
            afterCaller.fourth = beforeCaller.fourth ∧ final = {memos with query := guardSaved}) ∧
          (reached = true →
            ∃ (reachedPhysical : SourceCurrentConjunctionRowsAllocation.State Symbol FullSyntax.Formula),
              afterCaller.checked = SourceCurrentAllocatedQueryMemo.advancePhysical queried reachedPhysical ∧
              ∃ actual : SourceCurrentConjunctionMemo.Call 1000 beforeCaller.fourth query
                  (physical queried) answer reachedPhysical afterCaller.fourth,
                SourceCurrentConjunctionGlobalMemos.CallReads actual {memos with query := guardSaved} final))

fields.name: actualDone
fields.type: SourceEqualityNativeDemand.execute fuel (.code (SourceRecursiveIntersectionCode.requestNode IntersectionEmptyDomain.emptyDomain left right)) beforeCaller.checked = .done query queried

fields.name: emptyRaw
fields.type: replacement = .empty → ExceptT.run (SourcePruningEnumerationAssimilation.finish (EnumGuard := EnumGuard) source target handle sourceScs targetScs replacement before) = []

fields.name: nonemptyRaw
fields.type: replacement ≠ .empty → ∃ after : EnumerationState.State Symbol EnumGuard, ExceptT.run (SourcePruningEnumerationAssimilation.finish (EnumGuard := EnumGuard) source target handle sourceScs targetScs replacement before) = [.ok ((), after)] ∧ after = assimilated before target source (.unenumerated (some handle) (sourceScs ++ targetScs)) ∧ after.values[target]? = some (.unenumerated (some handle) (sourceScs ++ targetScs)) ∧ after.values[source]? = some .eliminated ∧ PendingRealized afterCaller.checked.native.machine.heap after

fields.name: raw
fields.type: ExceptT.run (SourcePruningEnumerationAssimilation.finish (EnumGuard := EnumGuard) source target handle sourceScs targetScs replacement before) = [.ok ((), after)]

fields.name: afterSame
fields.type: after = assimilated before target source (.unenumerated (some handle) (sourceScs ++ targetScs))

fields.name: old
fields.type: .unenumerated (some node) scs ∈ before.values.set target (.unenumerated merged (sourceScs ++ targetScs))

fields.name: oldStored
fields.type: (before.values.set target (.unenumerated merged (sourceScs ++ targetScs)))[oldSlot]? = some (.unenumerated (some node) scs)
